.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/create/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the enum identifier (e.g. `{{script}} paymentStatus`).

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/list/ste.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] to list all enums (optionally filtered to those whose name contains searchTerm).

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/update/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> <change-request> to verify the enum identified by `<id>` exists before applying the change request.

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/delete/s.instruction: Run `{{script}} <id>` where `<id>` is the enum's id, to delete the corresponding enum file if it exists.
Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the enum's identifier, to print every "file path:line number" reference to that enum found in the codebase.

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/evaluate.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to evaluate the enum artifact identified by <id> (its PascalCase name resolves the file at src/src/enums/{Name}.enum.ts).

create.text: Scaffolds a new enum file at src/src/enums/{Name}.enum.ts with minimal members, given an id and optional member list.

list.text: Lists enum artifacts in the codebase matching an optional search term, printing each result's id and file path.

update.text: Updates an existing enum artifact's source file to satisfy a natural-language change request, given its id, erroring if the enum doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes the enum artifact with the given id from src/src/enums, removing its file and cleaning up dangling references to it across the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that an enum artifact's file location, single top-level shape, and closed member set comply with the rules, given the enum's id, printing pass or itemized rule violations.
